name: forge-vtt-shared-compendiums-oracle-of-echoes
title: Oracle of Echoes (Shared Compendiums)
description:
I got tired of not having a class that really ‘chimed’ well with sonic damage, and for all the cool sonic spells we have, there is almost no synergy at all with anything. This new Oracle Mystery intends to change that. Many updates to come perhaps


Shared Compendium

This module allows you to share compendiums between your worlds.

It cannot be auto-updated, therefore it cannot overwrite your compendiums and is therefore safe to unlock.
author: The Forge
